definition: [ עָטַר ] verb surround (Late Hebrew id. , and derivatives; Phoenician עטרת wreath , עטר Pi`el denominative crown Lzb 339 ; Aramaic עֲטַר ; Assyrian etêru , spare , rescue ); — Qal Imperfect 2 masculine singular suffix כַּצִּנָּה רָצוֺן תַּעְטְרֶנּוּ Ps 5:13 as with a shield, with favour will thou surround him; Participle plural עֹטְרִים אֶלדָּֿוִד 1Sam 23:26 Saul and his men were surrounding (closing in) upon David.
